test_case.test_name: Per-memory-controller rank-0 uncorrectable ECC injection and recovery
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved rank-0 UCE through every in-scope memory controller and prove exact controller/physical-slot attribution, required platform indication and safe recovery/integrity.
required_package: Approved Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and UCE semantics
Backup, outage monitor, recovery, memory/data-integrity and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: After explicit FAE approval on an isolated backed-up SUT, preserve baseline evidence, capture `mc.dimminfo()`, verify the signed representative rank-0 tuple for one controller, and invoke `ei.injectMemError(socket, channel, dimm, sub_channel, rank=0, errType="uce")` once. Monitor any outage independently, recover only by the approved state machine, and collect complete Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI/front-panel evidence plus integrity/health before proceeding to the next controller.
test_case.expected_result: Each in-scope controller receives exactly one approved UCE and is attributed to the mapped physical slot across all mandatory evidence; the required indicator behavior matches platform applicability; any defined outage/recovery behavior follows the signed oracle; memory/data integrity and BIOS state return to the approved baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete controller coverage, verified tuple mapping, exact UCE severity and controller/slot identity, all mandatory evidence and successful recovery/integrity/restoration. Generic UCE text, wrong/missing controller, repeated errors, unapproved outage handling, missing indicator/UEFI evidence where applicable or integrity failure is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle backed-up SUT, stable power, independent console, approved harness and qualified FAE.
Preserve logs and validate each destructive tuple before one injection.
Stop on wrong attribution, uncontrolled MCE, unexpected outage, data-integrity concern or recovery failure.
No automatic reset, power cycle, retry or next-controller progression before complete recovery evidence.
expected_evidence: Harness hash, full mc.dimminfo and signed controller-to-tuple matrix
Authoritative Windows UCE, BMC slot/controller and applicable UEFI evidence
Memory/data integrity, BIOS restoration, health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any outage or anomaly, preserve BMC/console evidence and let the qualified owner follow the documented recovery state machine. Verify boot, memory health, data/filesystem integrity and BIOS settings before any separately authorized next injection; never retry automatically.
